added_lines: Mass: 106.5 FM --------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------- ------------- November 21st & 22nd 2026 – Feast of Christ the King Sat. 21st 8.00 pm Joe & Kitty Cuddy & deceased members of the Cuddy & Murphy families Tom & Annie Toolan & dec. Members of Toolan & Bowie families Sun. 22nd 9.45 am Feast of Christ the King - Private Intention Sun. 22nd 5.00 pm Service of Remembrance of the Dead Mon. 23rd 10.00 am Daily Mass - Holy Souls Tue. 24th 10.00 am Ann Jane & JP McDonagh & dec. members of the Howley & McDonagh families Wed. 25th - Friday 27th 10.00 am Daily Mass – Holy Souls Sat. 28th 8.00 pm Annie & Charlie Wims, Crrownagcleragh & deceased of the Wims and Collery families Sun. 29th 9.45 am First Sunday of Advent We remember in our prayers - the soul of Eithne Flanagan (nee Shiel) whose fu neral took place in Killeshandra County Cavan on Nov. 13th last. Sympathy to her son Connor (in Knockadoo) and Etna and their family. I. Killoran Community Centre - Card games continue every Wednesday evening at 9 pm . All new members welcome. Offertory Collection (Nov. 14th & 15th) Many thanks for your ongoing generosity. It is much appreciated. Charity Tax Rebate Scheme – the parish hopes to submit a claim to Revenue in Jan. 2027 for the 2026 financial year. The scheme allows all registered and regulated char ities (including parishes) to reclaim the tax compo nent of charitable donations made in a given year. If you paytax and have contributed €250 or more, then your donations will already have been taxed. Revenue will refund the parish a standard 45 cents for every €1 donated. More infor mation located at exit doors. Please take a copy of the green flyer home and, if you can help, fill in the minimal details and retur n. Many thanks to all who have already signed and retu rned the form. Replacement Lights – have been fitted to Coolaney Church during the we ek – both inside and outside. Ongoing works like these are made possible, in part, through the Charity Tax Rebate Scheme . If you paytax, and you haven’t already taken a green form home, please do so and return when you get a chance. It really makes a big differen ce. An Assembly – of the dioceses of Achonry and Elphin will take p lace on Saturday, February 20th 2027 in St. Nathy’s College, Ballaghaderreen. At least two members of t he laity from each parish are asked to attend. If i nterested, please give your name to Fr. Martin or to Fr. Gerry by Dec ember 11th “Arising out of the recent universal synergy, dioces es all over the world have now been asked to hold an Assem bly in the first half of 2027 in order to recall wh at has been done over recent years, to recognize what has borne frui t, and also to acknowledge the difficulties and the resistance that we experienced, in ourselves or in others. We look back in order to see where we have come from, while asking the Holy Spirit to show us what we need to do next.” (Bishop Kevin Doran) November Masses for the dead – are celebrated each weekday morning throughout t he month. Names of deceased loved ones can be written on the sheets provided. Dates for your Diary Sunday, November 22nd Service of Remembrance of the Dead – 5.00 pm Wednesday, November 25th General Clean-up of the Church – from 10.30 am onwa rds – Volunteers needed please Sunday, December 20th Carol Service with the Coolaney Gospel Choir – 6.00 pm Church Rotas – many thanks to all who are involved in the vario us ministries, especially at the weekend Masses – Just a reminder …. if someone on a rota can’t make it, it would be appreciated if others could stand in for them. General Clean-Up of the church takes place on Wed. morning next at 10.30am. All help appreciated. Many hands etc Coolaney Church – will be closed and locked each evening at 5.00 throughout the winter months. Offertory Envelopes for 2027 – are available at St. Joseph’s altar. First and fo remost, a big thank you for your ongoing very generous support of the church. It is much appreciated. The weekly figures published in t he Newsletter speak for themselves. The envelope system also allo ws the parish to claim back the tax that has already been paid on donations. If you can help in this respect, please do. Early next year there will be a summary of chur ch accounts for 2026 made available to parishioners. Individual sta tements are also available on request. Many thanks for your support Masses can be booked – directly through the parish office in Collooney (071) 9167235 or indirectly with Fr. Gerry. Deadline - for receipt of News Items / Mass Intentions in Coll ooney office is 12.00 pm on the previous Wednesday. Thought for the Day - We can’t direct the wind, but we can adjust the sails (Dolly Parton). Online Newsletter – with additional items can be found on the as the church webcam is located. Coolaney

Revised Traffic Plans for outside Rockfield Church – No updates. Blue November Offering Envelopes – are included in the box of Offertory Envelopes. They are intended for anyone who would like to make an offering for Masses said for the dead throughout November. All the dead will be prayed for, irrespective or an offering made or not. All weekday Masses throughout November will be said for the Holy Souls. For those who would like the names of their dead includ ed, they can put a list into the blue envelope or, alternatively, write on the paper insert of the separate November envelo pes at the doors. There will be a basket in front o f the altar for the envelopes / names. If putting money into an envelope, return it in the Offertory Collection or hand di rectly to Fr. Gerry. All donations go to the Coolaney Priest Wages Accou nt. Please do not put money in an envelope and leave it in the church. A Bereavement Course - presented by Monica Morley, Director of the Knoc k Shrine Family Centre and Broadcaster at Midwest Radio is due to commence Tuesday 3rd November at 8pm at The Newman Institute, Ballina. The cost of the course is €60 and will run for the 4 Tuesday n ights in November. To book a place please phone

. One Day Advent Retreat Late Autumn Fr Peyton Centre, Attymass, Ballina Co. Mayo F26 X884 Advent Retreat: What Gift will you Give? Saturday December 5th, beginning at 11am, and concluding at 4.30pm, the day includes: spiritual talks, reflection, quiet time, rosary and Mass. The cost is €25, which includes tea, coffee on arrival & light lunch. Booking is essential. For en quiries and booking contact Fina
